title: お歳暮の贈り物
subject_en: Year-end gift items (oseibo), each ONE item centred in its cell, flat illustration; any gift wrapping paper is plain with a red and white knot ribbon and NO characters. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: ハム、ビール、みかん、洗剤、のしつきの箱など、お歳暮の贈り物6点。お礼状やお知らせ、特集ページに。
items: a wrapped gift box with a red and white knot ribbon
a gift box of ham and sausages
a gift set of beer cans in a box
a wooden box full of tangerines
a gift set of soap bottles in a box
